name: The Spiral Skein (Summerset)
summary: This article is about the portion of the realm visited in the Summerset chapter. For the portion visited during the Summerset prologue, see The Spiral Skein (prologue). The Spiral Skein is a part of Mephala's realm of Oblivion. This part of the realm is where the Golden Knight has been imprisoned, and is visited during the related quest.
